reviews.text: Friendly and nice food
Love this place! Art is great, staff are friendly! Will be back for sure

Great cannabis coffee shop!! They have got a nice selection of cali weed. Staff were funny and very welcoming. Decor of the shop is beautiful with a great atmosphere. You can also get cbd Thai local food which is out of the world with flavour. This is the spot to go!!! Recommend to all ❤️
Best coffee shop I’ve ever been to make sure you go there. Best weed in Thailand
Visited here recently when it had just opened ! Lovely vibe would definitely come again highly recommend!!

Very nice Cannbis coffee shop designs  artworks is wicked. They had definitely had the best weed in patong good selection of cali weed and very good quality Thai 🇹🇭flower. Staff is polite and very funny. All round good atmosphere and great shop to stop and smoke. They EVEN have cbd Thai local food which is out of the world with flavour. Highly recommend 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Great weed, cool cats and staff! Laundry shop next door super convenient if you're staying at the Royal Paradise.
Lovely host, lovely atmosphere, and lovely weed. Easy recommendation!
I was stunned by the girl over the counter. She is so perfect in those round glasses. Weed was 10/10 too :)
Loved the atmosphere and music, cool staff and good ganja!!
Nice staff and cozy place

Super cosy place with a couple of different areas to chill and smoke, inside and outside. Several different strains of weed to choose from and decent prices! The girls that work there are super friendly and love to chat if you want.
huge selection ranging 18-30% and great prices and really nice area to smoke
Great atmosphere with friendly staff! Got good variety with attractive pricing.
Amazing hospitality with affordable prices!🫶🏻

Great shop amazing staff.
Always looking to keep the staff happy.
Plus they have a cat called dirty boy!!!

Nice place to chill, for couple drinks or beers good quality weed not expensive.
Very convenient laundromat  at the same place. Can have a J while you wait for it!!

Blow paradise has a really fun friendly atmosphere with really helpful friendly staff. I appreciate how professional and well kept the store is. But most importantly the product is very high quality, I especially like the ‘Grape ape” sativa strain which I purchased as a pre roll.
It’s a good place to chill
